text:
Hamburg’s median asking rents sit at 15.47 €/m², five‑year growth 28.5 % and a 5.1 % year‑on‑year rise, placing the city fifth among the 37 most expensive German markets. The market remains tight, with a vacancy rate of 1.0 % and an average of 23 days on market; 37 % of listings are let within a week.

Affordability is pressured: the median 60 m² rent is 928 € per month and the rent‑burden for two residents is 18.8 %. Asking rents are about 69 % above the 2022 existing‑rent level of 9.16 €/m², reflecting a strong premium.

The model estimate forecasts median asking rents of 16.28 €/m² in 12 months, ranging from 15.91 €/m² to 16.67 €/m², implying a further 5.2 % increase.
